bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 7, 8. KIWI HARMONY finished unplaced over 1400m at Coffs Harbour last start however her effort was far better than it appears on paper and she can be expected to relish stepping back up to this distance this afternoon. IRISH ACCOLADE performed above market place expectations at Gunnedah with Olivia Dalton aboard and he can be expected to maintain his form today with Olivia retaining the ride. NARUKAMI presents after a freshen-up and also after a stable change. Stepping back in distance should not be considered as a minus here, aided by the claim for Liberty Smyth. SCRAMBLING was a dual acceptor who can return to the races as an improved three-year-old first up and at only his second run in a race. He hasn't however trialed beforehand and especially over this distance, market moves after he parades should be greatly respected?

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 6, 7. ZOUS APOLLO presents first up and although he finished unplaced at all five starts in his first campaign, there were excuses on numerous occasions and this journey should suit first up. BON BATAN performed well above market place expectations second up at Inverell and a step back in distance can be coped with today, after a five week break. SCRAMBLING was also an acceptor for race one. He was spelled after his honest Coffs Harbour effort back in May when 805m wasn't suitable after he was slow to leave the gates. He can return improved today in whichever race he contests. ROSENBAUM endured too tough a run first up at Coffs Harbour and the addition of blinkers aids the cause today. THE MICHAEL resumes after trialing at the end of July. Neither unplaced effort at Tuncurry before his spell should be regarded as a concern today, his beaten margin from both races is misleading and at his only other outing to date, he was honest in defeat.
